1. the costs and benefits to society of neonatal screening; 2. the cost effectiveness of screening; 3. the cost effectiveness and cost benefit of alternative screening strategies; 4. the cost effectiveness, and cost effectiveness acceptability of screening in relation to the severity of the condition; and 5. the impact of screening on maternal and child health.

the cost-effectiveness of the neonatal screening programme is sensitive to the incidence of PKU, the prevalence of maternal PKU and the cost of treatment of PKU.
